text: tools/list contains schedule_resume with required key and reason, the documented parameters, and no agent_id/thread_id parameter

Given caller context (thread t1, agent a1) and a stub platform, When schedule_resume is called with resume_in='3m', key and reason, Then the stub receives POST /api/agents/a1/threads/t1/schedule-resume with exactly those fields and the tool returns the stub answer unchanged
Given two calls with the same key, Then both post the same path with the same key (the endpoint moves the wait) and the second answer is returned unchanged
Given the stub raises 422 (date with no time / beyond horizon), 429 (cap reached) or 403, Then the tool returns an error envelope carrying the endpoint message (429 code limit_reached, not retryable)
Given the stub raises 404 'Not found' (feature flag off), Then the tool returns the not_available envelope; given 404 'Agent not found' the code stays not_found
Given both or neither of resume_at/resume_in, a missing key or reason, or no thread/agent id in the caller context, Then an error envelope comes back and the stub is never called
Through the ASGI app, X-Channel-Thread-Id and X-Channel-Agent-Id reach get_caller_from_context(), and a request without them is not rejected with 401

expect: Tool present; run shows Scheduled with a local resume time, then resumes in the same run about 3 minutes later; with the repeated key only one wait exists and it fires at the later time
